response.sql: WITH project_funding_with_spatial AS (SELECT p.fundflux, sp.domainregistry FROM scanspatial sp INNER JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry), funding_coverage AS (SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) as coverage_count FROM project_funding_with_spatial GROUP BY fundflux), coverage_stats AS (SELECT SUM(coverage_count) as total_coverage, AVG(coverage_count) as avg_coverage FROM funding_coverage) SELECT fc.fundflux as source, fc.coverage_count as count, CAST(fc.coverage_count AS DECIMAL) / CAST(cs.total_coverage AS DECIMAL) as share, fc.coverage_count - cs.avg_coverage as above_average FROM funding_coverage fc CROSS JOIN coverage_stats cs WHERE fc.coverage_count > cs.avg_coverage ORDER BY fc.coverage_count DESC
